name: io.github.boostuagency/boostu-exactonline-mcp
description: MCP server for Exact Online. Use your accounting data in Claude and other AI assistants.

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Exact App Center app

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret of your Exact App Center app

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 refresh token from the one-time authorization

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Exact Online region: be, nl, de, fr, uk, es or com (default be)

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_TOKEN_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Path to persist the rotated refresh token (default .exact-token)

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_DIVISION
environmentVariables.description: Pin every call to one division code (default: the user's current division)

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose read tools only

environmentVariables.name: EXACT_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable (default: all groups)
